## Top patient questions

**Who is Mr Najib Daulatzai?**  
A consultant colorectal and general surgeon in London and Hertfordshire, NHS and private, robotic-trained on da Vinci Xi and DV5.

**How do I book?**  
Phone +44 7733 897972 or email info@ndaulatzai.com. Private appointments often within one week.

**Does he do robotic bowel surgery?**  
Yes — robotic colorectal surgery at Spire Bushey, HCA Wellington, and NHS Watford.

**Which insurers?**  
Bupa, AXA Health, Aviva, Vitality, WPA, Healix; self-pay welcome.

**NHS referrals?**  
GP e-RS to West Hertfordshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust, colorectal surgery.
